newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian Suramericana de Seguros Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Colombian Suramericana de Seguros Q1 net.

text.p: Colombia's largest insurance company, Suramericana de Seguros, reported a 161 percent increase in first-quarter net profits, the banking superintendency said Thursday.
The superintendency said the company's net profits had risen to 60.94 billion pesos compared to 23.34 billion in the first quarter of 1996.

Suramericana de Seguros, the flagship company of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, reported total assets to March this year of 1.33 trillion pesos. No comparative figure was available for the first quarter of 1996.
A company spokesman said the surge in profits was partly due to the booming value of the company's share portfolio.
